description: OPTIONAL convenience for a SINGLE foreground call. Internally polls until finalized or a ~180s hard cap, then degrades to the non-blocking contract (returns call_id to keep polling). NOT for campaigns. 402 errors (trial_exhausted / plan_required / reserved_number_required) are PERMANENT gating, not retryable. Surface action.url and action.sign_in_url to the user verbatim. Do not retry. Trial limits come from the live quota object in the error envelope — never assume a fixed number.

bridge_number.description: Optional US E.164; enables mid-call loop_in_user handoff to this number

greeting.description: Optional outbound opener context. Does NOT set the agent's first spoken line — the opener is hardcoded server-side to a recording disclosure.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before degrading to poll. Default 180, ceiling 240.

personality.description: Optional reusable style/tone. Do NOT put one-call facts here

task.description: Full briefing memo — the agent's ONLY knowledge of the call's purpose and context

voice.description: Optional voice: jessica (default), sarah, chris, or eric

name: place_call_and_wait
